contran_945.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
Every lashed unit has lashings rated for at least twice its weight.
Each unit is secured with at least 4 lashing terminals.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
Nothing above the headboard can slide forward over it.

securing.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
Every lashed unit has lashings rated for at least twice its weight.
Each unit is secured with at least 4 lashing terminals.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
Nothing above the headboard can slide forward over it.
Every article's tiedowns add up to at least half its weight.
Every article has the tiedowns 393.110 asks for its length and weight.
Confirm the headboard is rated for the forward load 393.114(c) asks for.
Applies to cargo inside a van's walls.
No article on the deck is likely to roll.
No metal coils of 5,000 lb or more.
No machinery of 10,000 lb or more.
Tiedowns are hooked to the truck's anchor points.
No ropes.

dimensions.article: No federal height limit (FHWA); states: 13 ft 6 in to 14 ft 6 in

securing.message: Held forward at 0.8 g.
Held sideways at 0.5 g.
Held rearward at 0.5 g.
Every unit is stable on its own (EN 12195-1 eq. 3).
A flatbed's headboard has no EN 12642 code given.
No cargo leans on a flatbed's headboard.
Rated web lashings or chains, marked with their LC and STF.
The lashing points hold what the lashings pull.

protection.article: EN 12195-1 Annex B; Annex III Table 1 item 20.4
